statement: ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : WSpace n × ℝ → F) (c : F) (O : Set (WSpace n × ℝ)), IsOpen O → (∀ p ∈ O, f p = c) → ∀ p ∈ O, wT f p = 0 ∧ ∀ j, wX f j p = 0
proof:
intro F _ _ f c O hO hf p hp
have he : f =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun _ => c) := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hp) hf
constructor
· have hline : (fun r => f (p.1,r)) =ᶠ[𝓝 p.2] (fun _ => c) := he.comp_tendsto (continuousAt_const.prodMk continuousAt_id)
  change deriv (fun r => f (p.1,r)) p.2 = 0
  rw [hline.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
· intro j
  have hline : (fun x => f (x,p.2)) =ᶠ[𝓝 p.1] (fun _ => c) := he.comp_tendsto (continuousAt_id.prodMk continuousAt_const)
  change fderiv ℝ (fun x => f (x,p.2)) p.1 (Pi.single j 1) = 0
  rw [hline.fderiv_eq, fderiv_const]
  rfl
